name: Selection Speech TTS
author: Computing4All

sections.description:
Selection Speech TTS improves website accessibility and engagement by enabling users to select any visible text and have it read aloud using the browser’s built-in speech synthesis (Web Speech API). No need for costly APIs from AWS, OpenAI, Azure, or Google.

Designed with a clean interface and minimal overhead, this plugin adds a draggable mini-player to your site, offering users instant audio playback with real-time word highlighting.

Features:
– One-click speech playback for selected text
– Draggable mini-player with intuitive controls
– Uses browser-native voice (no external APIs required)
– Admin dashboard with usage tracking
– Unlimited plays
– Lightweight and fast

Ideal for:
– Enhancing accessibility for visually impaired users
– Supporting auditory learners
– Adding interactivity to blogs, educational, or informational websites
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Visit your site, select any text, and click the play button to hear it aloud.
sections.faq:
Does it work in all browsers?

Most modern browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari) support the Web Speech API, which this plugin uses. Voice support may vary slightly between platforms and devices.

Can I change the voice or language?

The plugin currently uses the browser’s default voice. Custom voice and language settings are planned for a future release.
